domain-information: An owner sends a design request to an architect.
An owner reviews the proposed blueprint before approving the final design.
An owner submits a permit application containing the blueprint to a city officer for construction approval.
An owner hires a construction overseer.
An architect creates a detailed blueprint for the house based on the owner’s reqeust.
An architect updates the blueprint after the city requests design adjustments.
A city officer reviews the permit application.
A city officer sends a construction permit to an construction overseer after approving the application.
A city officer makes an inspection of the construction project.
A construction overseer opens a construction project after receiving the construction permit.
A construction overseer assigns the blueprint to the project.
Construction workers are assigned to the construction project.
A construction overseer updates the project schedule.
A construction overseer gives instructions to the construction workers.
A construction worker follows overseer’s instructions.
A construction worker reports a safety concern to the overseer for resolution.

domain objects.name: Owner
domain objects.description: Person who commissions and finances the construction project.

domain objects.name: Design Request
domain objects.description: A request from the owner to the architect describing design needs and requirements.

domain objects.name: Architect
domain objects.description: Professional responsible for creating and updating blueprints based on design requests and regulations.

domain objects.name: Blueprint
domain objects.description: Detailed architectural plan that defines the structure and layout of the building.

domain objects.name: Permit Application
domain objects.description: Formal application submitted to the city for approval to begin construction, containing the blueprint.

domain objects.name: Construction Permit
domain objects.description: Official approval document from the city that authorizes the start of construction.

domain objects.name: City Officer
domain objects.description: Official responsible for reviewing permits and conducting inspections to ensure compliance.

domain objects.name: Construction Project
domain objects.description: Active building project managed by the overseer and executed by workers.

domain objects.name: Construction Worker
domain objects.description: Laborer who carries out construction tasks according to overseer instructions.

domain objects.name: Project Schedule
domain objects.description: Timeline and sequence of construction activities for the project.

domain objects.name: Inspection
domain objects.description: City officer’s evaluation of the construction site for compliance with safety and building standards.

domain objects.name: Construction Overseer
domain objects.description: Manager responsible for executing the project, coordinating workers, and maintaining safety and progress.

domain objects.name: Safety Concern Report
domain objects.description: Notice raised by a worker to report potential hazards or unsafe conditions to the overseer.

domain objects.name: Instruction
domain objects.description: Task or directive given by the overseer to guide worker activities on site.

associations.description: Owner sends a design request to Architect.
Owner reviews and approves the blueprint.
Owner submits a permit application containing the blueprint.
Owner hires the construction overseer for the project.
City officer reviews the permit application for approval.
City officer conducts an inspection of the project.
Inspection checks the progress of the construction project.
City officer issues a construction permit after approval.
Construction permit authorizes the overseer to start the project.
Construction overseer manages the construction project.
Construction overseer gives instructions for the project work.
Instruction guides the construction worker’s tasks.
Construction worker files a safety concern report.
Safety concern report is sent to the construction overseer for action.
